subject: Cohort welcome: the Academy
body:
Welcome to the Academy

Keep a learning journal somewhere you can find it again. You will want the questions you got wrong as well as the examples that worked. Programs has the timetable and the current setup link.

Local history, according to the welcome tradition: the founding lecturer died before delivering his final lecture. The Grey Lecturer still walks the server room at night, looking for his slides. If you hear someone grumbling about missing slides, please check whether it's your living teacher first.

We'll leave the ghost story there and get on with the exercises. Marcus
title: Cohort welcome: the Academy
